upstream.license_observation: No LICENSE file was observed in the repository tree at the pinned commit; treat upstream code/blobs/configs as reference-only unless separate permission/license is established.

relationship_to_uploaded_addon.observation: The addon installer contains a commented dependency check for the older main-module name. The main module and processing addon are architecturally complementary.

evidence: NeedExposeAllRawSize is added for all five logical sensor names.
RawSnapshot expands the APS feature-type list substantially.
ProMode and NightMode are added with raw callback type 0 (MIPI RAW).
high_value_capability_changes.cameraboost_policy: candidate for guarded capability exposure; validate Camera2/HAL stream contracts before UI advertisement

evidence: HQRAW_NIGHT_LUX_DELAY_SWITCH and HQRAW_DRCGAIN_TRRIGGER are added to multiple rear sensors.
IS_SUPPORT_TURBORAW_FRAMELESS is added across all sensor configs.
Target APS library separately exposes 23821 hqRawParameters/turbohdrParameters.
high_value_capability_changes.cameraboost_policy: high-priority P0 capability map; preserve stock fallback and thermal guardrails

evidence: Night IZoom routing changes from 4SatR to 3SatR.
Preview IZoom range is widened from 6x-start to 2x-start.
Video IZoom gains extra operation modes and camera IDs.
Video zoom cap moves from 18x to 20x.
high_value_capability_changes.cameraboost_policy: use a target slot/routing map; do not infer physical cameras from tele2/utele labels
treat as an experimental branch, not a default; memory/bandwidth and quality regression tests required

evidence: OemSupportedVSR is broadened from selected camera IDs to cameraid=-1.
Stock OnePlus 13 already contains GAN/highmagsol/Stable-Diffusion-style HybridRAW assets.
high_value_capability_changes.cameraboost_policy: separate feature enabling from donor model replacement

aggressive_quality_changes.evidence: For main-camera HDR/coupleHDR tables, many luminance-denoise, color-denoise and sharpness levels are set to zero versus non-zero stock values.
aggressive_quality_changes.risk: Can restore microdetail but may expose sensor noise, zippering, chroma noise, ringing from other stages, or merge artifacts.

aggressive_quality_changes.evidence: Main-camera AI-night zoom parameters set sharpening and denoise to 0 for most 1x-5x points, retaining only a small amount at the terminal 99x bucket.
aggressive_quality_changes.risk: Aesthetic tuning, not a universal correctness fix.
Should be exposed as a detail profile, not hard-coded for every user.

performance_and_thermal_risks: system.prop overrides real-time and non-real-time max image buffer counts to 0xffffffff.
persist props request 0xffffffff CSID/IFE clock and camera NoC/external bandwidth values.
overrideOPPCLOCK is set to 15 and IFEnumFramesHighBW to 12.
DecidePerfLimitFPS_Oplus raises capture keep FPS 20 -> 60 and thermal thresholds to 50/47 while targeting 60 FPS.
Extra HAL buffers are expanded and 0x80C1 is added to the capture mode list.
These are unsuitable as unconditional CameraBoost defaults; use a mode-aware resource governor instead.
upstream_reported_known_bugs: ultrawide-to-main camera switching in photo modes can hang the camera
processing addon can show merge bleed when sun hits the camera at an angle
processing addon reports zoom above 10x may fail to save the final image

cameraboost_architecture_decision.capability_layer: Import only evidence-backed feature gates, stream/RAW exposure and target-specific decision mapping.
cameraboost_architecture_decision.quality_layer: Represent denoise/sharpen/tone changes as selectable profiles with conservative defaults, never a single hard-coded zero-everything policy.
cameraboost_architecture_decision.processing_layer: Treat FX8U blobs/models as versioned optional deltas against the stock OnePlus 13 processing baseline.
cameraboost_architecture_decision.resource_layer: Replace global max-clock/max-bandwidth properties with mode-aware boosts bounded by thermal and memory pressure.
cameraboost_architecture_decision.compatibility_layer: Pin firmware/config fingerprints and fail closed when the target ABI/config family is unknown.

stock_baseline_stability.conclusion: The five sensor configs and CameraHWConfiguration used for the OCVM v61.82 delta are byte-identical in the public stock extraction from OOS 11.F.89 through 11.F.93. The observed OCVM differences are therefore not artifacts of those later OTA revisions.
